name: specialist
summary: A player who insists on their professional identity and solves problems through it.
special: Solve problems the way your profession would, and say which professional knowledge you are using.
When offered a generic approach, look for the one your speciality gives you instead.
Ask for the things your profession would ask for: records, a body, a permit, a colleague's opinion.

natural_investigator.creation_brief: A university lecturer in folklore and occult history. Strong Occult, History, Library Use.

probes: whether a speciality opens a route a generalist lacks
whether it collapses into a generic social or observation check
